# MDL506 · `sql-unbalanced`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

An SQL value has unbalanced parentheses, quotes or comments.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |

## Why

mydumper pastes `where`, `columns_on_select`, `columns_on_insert` and `columns_on_select_replace*` into the SQL it sends. An unclosed quote, parenthesis or `/* */` comment makes the statement fail when the table is reached, after the dump has started, or swallows the rest of it.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
where=(id > 10 AND name = 'x'
columns_on_select=id, concat(name, 'x'), email /* note
[mydumper]
where=a = "b
```

```text
2:7-2:8 error MDL506[sql-unbalanced] the SQL of `where` has a `(` without `)`
  = The statement mydumper builds fails when the table is reached.
3:48-3:49 error MDL506[sql-unbalanced] the SQL of `columns_on_select` has an unclosed /* comment
  = The statement mydumper builds fails when the table is reached.
5:11-5:12 error MDL506[sql-unbalanced] the SQL of `where` has an unclosed " quote
  = The statement mydumper builds fails when the table is reached.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL506: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL506` on the line above it.
